test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Lalit sits fourth to the left of Purnima. Lalit is third from the left end. Leela is eleventh from the right end and an immediate neighbour of Lalit. Only four people sit between Sheetal and Lalit. Only four people sit between Sheetal and Neena. How many people are sitting in the row?
solution:
Given → Certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98e9805da102d33588b25d45862d3309c7e319b0dea7bcb9a250b2eefb55b054.png] 

1) Lalit sits fourth to the left of Purnima.

2) Lalit is third from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f07798fffb8ce4464bc5f91d407746fe31364eb07fa7fbbf276a71422623eed4.png] 

3) Only four people sit between Sheetal and Lalit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f8fbafd5665a6fda4df291365b1a9348118eaac333293b980aef05320668915.png] 

4) Only four people sit between Sheetal and Neena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44346675b658ad6f436853ec24f7fc896cc0730a7b6a420d00c745baf1cb914a.png] 

5) Leela is eleventh from the right end and an immediate neighbour of Lalit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3bcf6f261fbb15e5fdc00dd3e507381ebcd02af081740f1e91d5f53df653460.png] 

Here, 14 number of people are sitting in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "14".**
